common.milestone_pruning_rule: stop at epoch 2 only if broken or collapsed; terminal learned/frozen comparison at epoch 5
common.fairness_note: Learned is compared only with its frozen same-architecture control; one-versus-two FFN depth comparisons are labeled as a separate estimand.
